Subject: GPU pool sizing estimate and throughput assumptions

Folks,

Per Kim's checklist, attached is a concise sizing estimate that maps three scenarios to expected QPS and token throughput for typical LLM workloads. Key highlights:
- Small: 4x A10g-equivalent machines — ~1.5k prompt tokens/sec aggregate latencies suitable for low concurrency PoC
- Medium: 8x A10g-equivalent — ~3.2k tokens/sec; supports steady pilot traffic with batching
- Large: 16x A100-similar tranches — ~6k tokens/sec; recommended for production load beyond 50k monthly users

Lead-time assumptions (ballpark):
- Dedicated pool (hosted/reserved): 3–5 weeks to provision and validate once PO + deposit are in (depends on GPU inventory in region)
- Private (customer VPC or on-prem): 6–10 weeks for network validation, KMS integration, and on-prem install if hardware is provided; additional time if we need to procure hardware on your behalf

See attached: [Attachment: gpu-sizing-estimate.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Proposed cadence for condensed eval (if Acme pushes to start 2026-07-20):
- Week 1 (2026-07-20 -> 2026-07-24): Integration + smoke tests; baseline perf and sample prompts
- Week 2 (2026-07-27 -> 2026-07-31): Full load scenarios, regression checks, and quality signoff

If Acme confirms the condensed schedule, we can prioritize a pre-provisioning hold on the medium pool (reserve capacity slot) to shorten the overall timeline.
